entity.summary: Centralized digital-asset exchange established in 2021, operating under the DIFX and Digital Financial Exchange names with current crypto spot markets and multi-asset positioning.
entity.notes: The legacy difx.com domain currently redirects to the Digital Financial Exchange platform. CoinGecko identifies Cayman Islands incorporation and a 2021 establishment year and reports current BTC and ETH markets. Several AUD market figures are independently flagged as anomalous, so HEI relies only on the continuing platform and recently updated core markets for active status and makes no volume-quality claim.

evidence.title: DIFX official Digital Financial Exchange platform
evidence.notes: The current official DIFX domain redirects to the live Digital Financial Exchange platform, corroborating the continuing brand and service surface.

evidence.title: DIFX exchange profile and current markets
evidence.notes: Current independent profile identifies DIFX as a Cayman Islands centralized exchange established in 2021 and reports recently updated BTC and ETH spot markets. HEI does not rely on independently flagged anomalous AUD volume figures.
